# Roadmap

## Near-term

- Search result quality improvements (grouping and richer object labels)
- Better large-model responsiveness in tree/search updates
- Recent files and quick reopen workflow
- Improved diagnostics clarity for validation/export failures

## Mid-term

- Drag-and-drop file open
- Packaged desktop builds for Windows/macOS/Linux
- Optional export preview UX
- Better diagram-object synchronization for complex shapes

## Long-term

- Multi-file project/session workspace
- Extensibility hooks for custom views and workflows
